text: Becca and Tyler take a camcorder to an isolated farmhouse for five days with the grandparents they have never met. Nana and Pop Pop seem kind, but [the basement is forbidden and no one may leave their room after 9:30|rules|break the rule and pay]. Nana vomits in the dark and tries the children's locked door with a knife, a game of hide-and-seek turns frantic, and the children's film becomes a hunt for evidence that [these old people are not who they claim|threat|impostors and doubles], ending in [a game of Yahtzee no one wants to play|images|gatherings, games and closeness].
